), 4)
        end
        for i = 0, 3 do
            local row = sframe(Ghost, { Size = UDim2.new(1, -36, 0, 16), Position = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 28 + i * 22), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary, BackgroundTransparency = 0.2, ZIndex = SZ + 21 })
            corner(row, 6)
            corner(sframe(row, { Size = UDim2.new(0.45, 0, 0, 4), Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0.5, -2), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.TextDim, BackgroundTransparency = 0.3, ZIndex = SZ + 22 }), 2)
            local sw = sframe(row, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 10), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0.5, 0), BackgroundColor3 = i % 2 == 0 and Theme.ToggleOn or Theme.AccentOff, ZIndex = SZ + 22 })
            corner(sw, 5)
        end
    end
    local ghostOpen = false
    local function setGhost(open)
        ghostOpen = open
        if open then Ghost.Visible = true end
        TweenService:Create(Ghost, TweenInfo.new(open and 0.28 or 0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { GroupTransparency = open and 0 or 1 }):Play()
        local tw = TweenService:Create(GhostScale, TweenInfo.new(open and 0.32 or 0.18, open and Enum.EasingStyle.Back or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = open and 1 or 0.85 })
        tw:Play()
        if not open then
            tw.Completed:Connect(function()
                if not ghostOpen then Ghost.Visible = false end
            end)
        end
    end

    -- El botón flotante de la vista previa: mismo tamaño (42 px), círculo, borde y capas que el real
    local PvButton = mk("TextButton", {
        Parent = Stage,
        Name = "PreviewToggle",
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(42, 42),
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 52),
        BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Text = "",
        AutoButtonColor = false,
        ZIndex = SZ + 30,
    })
    corner(PvButton, 999)
    local PvStroke = mk("UIStroke", { Parent = PvButton, Color = Theme.Accent, Thickness = 1.5 })
    local PvPress = mk("UIScale", { Parent = PvButton, Scale = 1 })
    local function applyZoom()
        PvPress.Scale = LS.zoom
    end

    local Hint = mk("TextLabel", {
        Parent = Stage,
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 20),
        AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1),
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -8),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.45,
        TextColor3 = WHITE,
        TextSize = 10,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
        ZIndex = SZ + 40,
    })
    Hint:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)
    L(Hint, "Tocalo o arrastralo, igual que el de verdad", "Tap or drag it, just like the real one")
    corner(Hint, 999)
    pad(Hint, 0, 10, 10, 0)

    -- movimiento real: arrastrar dentro del escenario y tocar para abrir/cerrar
    do
        local dragging, moved, startInput, startPos = false, false, nil, nil
        PvButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragging, moved = true, false
                startInput, startPos = input.Position, PvButton.Position
                Content.ScrollingEnabled = false
                TweenService:Create(PvPress, TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 0.88 * LS.zoom }):Play()
            end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                local delta = input.Position - startInput
                if delta.Magnitude > 6 then moved = true end
                if moved then
                    local size = Stage.AbsoluteSize
                    local x = math.clamp(startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, 4, math.max(4, size.X - 46))
                    local y = math.clamp(startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y, 4, math.max(4, size.Y - 46))
                    PvButton.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
                end
            end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                dragging = false
                Content.ScrollingEnabled = true
                TweenService:Create(PvPress, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = LS.zoom }):Play()
                if Hint.Visible then
                    TweenService:Create(Hint, TweenInfo.new(0.3), { TextTransparency = 1, BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
                    task.delay(0.3, function() Hint.Visible = false end)
                end
                if not moved then
                    local cs = ED.rec and ED.rec.ClickSound
                    local sid = cs and CL.CleanAsset(cs.Id) or ""
                    if not ghostOpen then
                        playSound(sid ~= "" and sid or Sounds.Click, sid ~= "" and (cs.Volume or 0.6) or 0.6)
                    end
                    setGhost(not ghostOpen)
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    -- dibuja el logo del editor en el botón de la vista previa
    local function rebuildPreview()
        local old = LS.live
        for _, e in ipairs(old) do
            if e.label then e.label:Destroy() end
        end
        local icon = drawableIcon(ED.rec)
        paintButtonBase(PvButton, PvStroke, icon)
        LS.live = buildLayers(PvButton, icon.Layers, SZ + 30)
        -- se conserva el ángulo/tiempo de cada capa: mover un deslizador no reinicia la animación
        for i, e in ipairs(LS.live) do
            if old[i] then
                e.state = old[i].state
                if e.def.Movement == "Spin" then e.label.Rotation = e.state.angle end
            end
        end
    end

    -- barra de herramientas de la vista previa
    local Tools = mk("Frame", { Parent = PreviewCard, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = 2, ZIndex = Z + 3 })
    local backdropChips = chips(Tools, {
        { "day", "Día", "Day" }, { "night", "Noche", "Night" }, { "light", "Claro", "Light" }, { "checker", "Transparente", "Transparent" },
    }, 1, setBackdrop)
    backdropChips.Row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -112, 1, 0)
    local zoomChips = chips(Tools, { { 1, "1x", "1x" }, { 2, "2x", "2x" }, { 3, "3x", "3x" } }, 2, function(z)
        LS.zoom = z
        applyZoom()
    end)
    zoomChips.Row.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(108, 28)
    zoomChips.Row.Position = UDim2.new(1, -108, 0, 0)

    -- interruptor: verlo también en el botón flotante REAL mientras editás
    local RealRow = mk("TextButton", { Parent = PreviewCard, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background, BackgroundTransparency = 0.3, Text = "", LayoutOrder = 3, ZIndex = Z + 3 })
    RealRow:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
    corner(RealRow, 10)
    label(RealRow, "Ver en mi botón real", "Show on my real button", 12, Enum.Font.GothamBold, "Text", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 16), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 5), ZIndex = Z + 4 })
    label(RealRow, "El botón flotante de verdad cambia mientras editás", "The actual floating button changes while you edit", 9, Enum.Font.GothamMedium, "TextDim", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 12), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 22), ZIndex = Z + 4 })
    local RealTrack = mk("Frame", { Parent = RealRow, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 22), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0.5, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.AccentOff, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = Z + 4 })
    corner(RealTrack, 999)
    local RealKnob = mk("Frame", { Parent = RealTrack, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = Z + 5 })
    corner(RealKnob, 999)
    local PREVIEW_KEY = "Custom:__preview"
    local realToken = 0
    local function pushReal()
        if not LS.realLive then return end
        realToken += 1
        local my = realToken
        task.delay(0.2, function() -- un solo redibujo por ráfaga de cambios
            if my ~= realToken or not LS.realLive then return end
            local icon = drawableIcon(ED.rec)
            if #icon.Layers == 0 then return end
            icon.LabelES, icon.LabelEN, icon.Custom = "Vista previa", "Preview", true
            local cs = ED.rec.ClickSound
            if cs and CL.CleanAsset(cs.Id) ~= "" then icon.ClickSound = { Id = CL.CleanAsset(cs.Id), Volume = cs.Volume } end
            IconCatalog.Icons[PREVIEW_KEY] = icon
            pcall(ApplyLogoIcon, PREVIEW_KEY)
        end)
    end
    local function setRealLive(on)
        LS.realLive = on
        TweenService:Create(RealKnob, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(on and 21 or 3, 3) }):Play()
        RealTrack.BackgroundColor3 = on and Theme.ToggleOn or Theme.AccentOff
        if on then
            pushReal()
        else
            realToken += 1
            IconCatalog.Icons[PREVIEW_KEY] = nil
            pcall(ApplyLogoIcon, SavedConfig.SelectedLogoIcon or "ClassicYinYang")
        end
    end
    RealRow.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.4)
        setRealLive(not LS.realLive)
    end)

    local function changed()
        rebuildPreview()
        pushReal()
    end

    -- =====================================================================
    -- 2) NOMBRE + PLANTILLAS
    -- =====================================================================
    sectionTitle(Content, "NOMBRE Y PUNTO DE PARTIDA", "NAME & STARTING POINT", 2, "Empezá de cero o copiá un logo del catálogo y modificalo", "Start from scratch or copy a catalog logo and tweak it")
    local NameCard = card(Content, 3)
    pad(NameCard, 10, 10, 10, 10)
    list(NameCard, 8)
    local NameBox = mk("TextBox", {
        Parent = NameCard,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34),
        BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.2,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Text = "",
        PlaceholderColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
        TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
        TextSize = 13,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
        ClearTextOnFocus = false,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        LayoutOrder = 1,
        ZIndex = Z + 4,
    })
    NameBox:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
    NameBox:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
    NameBox:SetAttribute("PlaceholderSpanish", "Nombre de tu logo")
    NameBox:SetAttribute("PlaceholderEnglish", "Your logo name")
    NameBox.PlaceholderText = GetText("Nombre de tu logo", "Your logo name")
    corner(NameBox, 10)
    pad(NameBox, 0, 12, 12, 0)
    local nameStroke = stroke(NameBox, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.6)
    NameBox.Focused:Connect(function() nameStroke.Color = Theme.Accent nameStroke.Transparency = 0.1 end)
    NameBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
        nameStroke.Color = Theme.Stroke
        nameStroke.Transparency = 0.6
        ED.rec.Name = NameBox.Text:sub(1, 24)
    end)

    local TemplateRow = mk("ScrollingFrame", {
        Parent = NameCard,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 74),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.X,
        AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
        CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
        ScrollBarThickness = 0,
        LayoutOrder = 2,
        ZIndex = Z + 3,
    })
    list(TemplateRow, 8, true)

    local openEditor -- se define abajo
    local rebuildLayerCards, refreshBaseCard, refreshSoundCard -- idem

    local function loadRecIntoEditor(r, keepName)
        local name = keepName and ED.rec and ED.rec.Name or r.Name
        ED.rec = r
        ED.rec.Name = name or ""
        NameBox.Text = ED.rec.Name
        rebuildLayerCards()
        refreshBaseCard()
        refreshSoundCard()
        changed()
    end

    local function templateTile(order, es, en, iconForThumb, onPick)
        local t = mk("TextButton", { Parent = TemplateRow, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(70, 72), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background, BackgroundTransparency = 0.25, Text = "", LayoutOrder = order, ZIndex = Z + 4 })
        t:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
        corner(t, 12)
        stroke(t, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.7)
        local stage = mk("Frame", { Parent = t, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 44), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 6), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = Z + 5 })
        if iconForThumb then
            composite(stage, iconForThumb, 44, Z + 5)
        else
            local plus = label(stage, "+", "+", 26, Enum.Font.GothamBold, "Accent", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, ZIndex = Z + 6 })
            plus.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None
        end
        label(t, es, en, 9, Enum.Font.GothamBold, "Text", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 14), Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 1, -18), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, ZIndex = Z + 5 })
        RowKit.Control(t)
        t.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.4)
            onPick()
        end)
    end
    templateTile(0, "En blanco", "Blank", nil, function()
        loadRecIntoEditor(blankRec(), true)
        setStatus("Empezaste de cero: pegá el ID de tu imagen en la capa 1", "Fresh start: paste your image ID in layer 1", Theme.Accent)
    end)
    do
        local n = 0
        for _, key in ipairs(IconCatalog.Order or {}) do
            local icon = IconCatalog.Icons[key]
            -- solo íconos de capas (los dibujados por código o cápsula no se pueden copiar)
            if icon and type(icon.Layers) == "table" and #icon.Layers > 0 and type(icon.Build) ~= "function" and icon.Type ~= "Capsule" and not icon.Custom then
                n += 1
                local es, en = icon.LabelES or key, icon.LabelEN or icon.LabelES or key
                templateTile(n, es, en, recFromIcon(icon), function()
                    loadRecIntoEditor(recFromIcon(icon, ED.rec and ED.rec.Name or ""), true)
                    setStatus("Copiaste \"" .. es .. "\": ahora cambiá lo que quieras", "Copied \"" .. en .. "\": now change anything", Theme.Accent)
                end)
            end
        end
    end

    -- =====================================================================
    -- SELECTOR DE COLOR (mismo sistema que el creador de temas)
    -- =====================================================================
    local PK = { H = 0, S = 0, V = 1, onApply = nil, drag = nil }
    local PickOverlay = mk("Frame", { Parent = Panel, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 0.35, Visible = false, Active = true, ZIndex = Z + 60 })
    corner(PickOverlay, 16)
    local PickPanel = mk("Frame", { Parent = PickOverlay, Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 236), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background, BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = true, ZIndex = Z + 61 })
    PickPanel:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
    corner(PickPanel, 14)
    stroke(PickPanel, Theme.Stroke, 1.4, 0.2)
    local PickTitle = label(PickPanel, "Color", "Color", 14, Enum.Font.GothamBlack, "Text", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 20), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 10), ZIndex = Z + 62 })
    local PickArea = mk("Frame", { Parent = PickPanel, Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -20, 0, 140), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 38), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(0, 1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = true, ZIndex = Z + 62 })
    corner(PickArea, 8)
    local PickWhite = mk("Frame", { Parent = PickArea, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = Z + 63 })
    corner(PickWhite, 8)
    mk("UIGradient", { Parent = PickWhite, Color = ColorSequence.new(WHITE), Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }) })
    local PickBlack = mk("Frame", { Parent = PickWhite, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = Z + 64 })
    corner(PickBlack, 8)
    mk("UIGradient", { Parent = PickBlack, Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(0, 0, 0)), Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) }) })
    local PickHandle = mk("Frame", { Parent = PickArea, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 8), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = Z + 65 })
    corner(PickHandle, 999)
    mk("UIStroke", { Parent = PickHandle, Color = WHITE, Thickness = 2 })
    local PickHue = mk("Frame", { Parent = PickPanel, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 140), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -2, 0, 38), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = true, ZIndex = Z + 62 })
    corner(PickHue, 8)
    mk("UIGradient", {
        Parent = PickHue,
        Rotation = 90,
        Color = ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.17, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.33, Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.67, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 255)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.83, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 255)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)),
        }),
    })
    local PickHueHandle = mk("Frame", { Parent = PickHue, Size = UDim2.new(1, 8, 0, 5), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = Z + 65 })
    corner(PickHueHandle, 3)
    local PickSwatch = mk("Frame", { Parent = PickPanel, Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -40, 0, 46), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 26, 0, 38), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = Z + 62 })
    corner(PickSwatch, 10)
    stroke(PickSwatch, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.3)
    local PickHex = mk("TextBox", { Parent = PickPanel, Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -40, 0, 30), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 26, 0, 92), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary, BorderSizePixel = 0, Text = "", TextColor3 = Theme.Text, TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.Code, ClearTextOnFocus = false, ZIndex = Z + 62 })
    PickHex:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
    PickHex:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
    corner(PickHex, 8)
    local PickQuick = mk("Frame", { Parent = PickPanel, Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -40, 0, 48), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 26, 0, 130), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = Z + 62 })
    mk("UIGridLayout", { Parent = PickQuick, CellSize = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18), CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder })
    local PickCancel = button(PickPanel, "Cancelar", "Cancel", "Secondary", { Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -20, 0, 32), Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, -44), ZIndex = Z + 63 })
    local PickApply = button(PickPanel, "Aplicar", "Apply", "Accent", { Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -20, 0, 32), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 6, 1, -44), ZIndex = Z + 63, TextSize = 12 })
    local function pickColor() return Color3.fromHSV(PK.H, PK.S, PK.V) end
    local function pickRefresh()
        local c = pickColor()
        PickArea.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(PK.H, 1, 1)
        PickHandle.Position = UDim2.fromScale(PK.S, 1 - PK.V)
        PickHueHandle.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, PK.H)
        PickSwatch.BackgroundColor3 = c
        if not PickHex:IsFocused() then PickHex.Text = toHex(c) end
        if PK.onLive then PK.onLive(c) end
    end
    local function pickSet(c)
        local h, s, v = c:ToHSV()
        if s > 0.001 then PK.H = h end
        PK.S, PK.V = s, v
        pickRefresh()
    end
    for i, c in ipairs({
        Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Color3.fromRGB(255, 82, 82), Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 60), Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 70),
        Color3.fromRGB(110, 255, 120), Color3.fromRGB(60, 220, 255), Color3.fromRGB(90, 120, 255), Color3.fromRGB(180, 100, 255),
        Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 200), Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 130), Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 34), Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
    }) do
        local q = mk("TextButton", { Parent = PickQuick, BackgroundColor3 = c, Text = "", LayoutOrder = i, ZIndex = Z + 63 })
        corner(q, 999)
        mk("UIStroke", { Parent = q, Color = WHITE, Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.5 })
        q.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() pickSet(c) end)
    end
    local function pickAt(pos)
        if PK.drag == "SV" then
            local a, s = PickArea.AbsolutePosition, PickArea.AbsoluteSize
            if s.X <= 0 or s.Y <= 0 then return end
            PK.S = math.clamp((pos.X - a.X) / s.X, 0, 1)
            PK.V = math.clamp(1 - (pos.Y - a.Y) / s.Y, 0, 1)
        elseif PK.drag == "H" then
            local a, s = PickHue.AbsolutePosition, PickHue.AbsoluteSize
            if s.Y <= 0 then return end
            PK.H = math.clamp((pos.Y - a.Y) / s.Y, 0, 0.999)
        end
        pickRefresh()
    end
    local function isPress(input)
        return input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    end
    PickArea.InputBegan:Connect(function(input) if isPress(input) then PK.drag = "SV" pickAt(input.Position) end end)
    PickHue.InputBegan:Connect(function(input) if isPress(input) then PK.drag = "H" pickAt(input.Position) end end)
    PickHex.FocusLost:Connect(function()
        local c = fromHex(PickHex.Text)
        if c then pickSet(c) else pickRefresh() end
    end)
    local function closePicker(apply)
        PickOverlay.Visible = false
        PK.drag = nil
        if apply and PK.onApply then PK.onApply(pickColor()) elseif PK.onCancel then PK.onCancel() end
        PK.onApply, PK.onCancel, PK.onLive = nil, nil, nil
    end
    PickCancel.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() closePicker(false) end)
    PickApply.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() closePicker(true) end)
    -- onLive pinta en vivo; Cancelar vuelve al color de antes
    local function openPicker(es, en, current, onLive, onApply, onCancel)
        L(PickTitle, es, en)
        PK.onLive, PK.onApply, PK.onCancel = nil, onApply, onCancel
        PickOverlay.Visible = true
        pickSet(current or WHITE)
        PK.onLive = onLive
    end

    -- =====================================================================
    -- DESLIZADORES (uno solo escucha el arrastre para todos)
    -- =====================================================================
    local activeSlider = nil
    local function slider(parent, order, es, en, cfg, value, onChange)
        local s = { cfg = cfg, value = value }
        local holder = mk("Frame", { Parent = parent, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = order, ZIndex = Z + 4 })
        s.Holder = holder
        s.Label = label(holder, es, en, 11, Enum.Font.GothamBold, "Text", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 16), ZIndex = Z + 5 })
        s.Value = label(holder, "", "", 11, Enum.Font.Code, "Accent", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(66, 16), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, ZIndex = Z + 5 })
        local track = mk("Frame", { Parent = holder, Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 6), Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 26), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.SliderTrack or Theme.AccentOff, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = Z + 5 })
        track:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "SliderTrack")
        corner(track, 999)
        local fill = mk("Frame", { Parent = track, Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.SliderFill or Theme.Accent, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = Z + 6 })
        fill:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "SliderFill")
        corner(fill, 999)
        local knob = mk("Frame", { Parent = track, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.5), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = Z + 7 })
        corner(knob, 999)
        mk("UIStroke", { Parent = knob, Color = Theme.SliderThumb or Theme.Accent, Thickness = 2 }):SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "SliderThumb")
        local hit = mk("TextButton", { Parent = holder, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 17), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", ZIndex = Z + 8 })
        function s.Set(v, fire)
            local c = s.cfg
            v = math.clamp(v, c[1], c[2])
            v = math.floor((v - c[1]) / c[3] + 0.5) * c[3] + c[1]
            v = math.clamp(v, c[1], c[2])
            s.value = v
            local a = (c[2] > c[1]) and (v - c[1]) / (c[2] - c[1]) or 0
            fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(a, 1)
            knob.Position = UDim2.fromScale(a, 0.5)
            s.Value.Text = fmtNum(v, c[3]) .. (c[5] or "")
            if fire then onChange(v) end
        end
        function s.Configure(cfgNew, es2, en2, v)
            s.cfg = cfgNew
            if es2 then L(s.Label, es2, en2) end
            s.Set(v or s.value, false)
        end
        function s.At(x)
            local a, w = track.AbsolutePosition.X, track.AbsoluteSize.X
            if w <= 0 then return end
            local c = s.cfg
            s.Set(c[1] + math.clamp((x - a) / w, 0, 1) * (c[2] - c[1]), true)
        end
        hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if isPress(input) then
                activeSlider = s
                Content.ScrollingEnabled = false
                TweenService:Create(knob, TweenInfo.new(0.1), { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20) }):Play()
                s.At(input.Position.X)
            end
        end)
        s.Knob = knob
        s.Set(value, false)
        return s
    end
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
        if activeSlider then activeSlider.At(input.Position.X) end
        if PK.drag then pickAt(input.Position) end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if not isPress(input) then return end
        if activeSlider then
            TweenService:Create(activeSlider.Knob, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16) }):Play()
            activeSlider = nil
            Content.ScrollingEnabled = true
        end
        PK.drag = nil
    end)

    -- muestra de color tocable (abre el selector)
    local function swatchRow(parent, order, es, en, getColor, setColor, defaultEs, defaultEn)
        local row = mk("Frame", { Parent = parent, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = order, ZIndex = Z + 4 })
        label(row, es, en, 11, Enum.Font.GothamBold, "Text", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -150, 1, 0), ZIndex = Z + 5 })
        local sw = mk("TextButton", { Parent = row, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(64, 28), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -78, 0.5, 0), Text = "", ZIndex = Z + 5 })
        corner(sw, 8)
        mk("UIStroke", { Parent = sw, Color = WHITE, Thickness = 1.5, Transparency = 0.4 })
        local reset = button(row, defaultEs, defaultEn, "Background", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(72, 28), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0), TextSize = 10 })
        local api = {}
        function api.Refresh()
            local c = getColor()
            sw.BackgroundColor3 = c or Theme.Accent
            reset.BackgroundTransparency = c and 0.2 or 0.75
        end
        sw.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            local before = getColor()
            openPicker(es, en, before or Theme.Accent, function(c)
                setColor(c)
                api.Refresh()
                changed()
            end, function(c)
                setColor(c)
                api.Refresh()
                changed()
            end, function()
                setColor(before)
                api.Refresh()
                changed()
            end)
        end)
        reset.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            setColor(nil)
            api.Refresh()
            changed()
        end)
        api.Row = row
        return api
    end

    -- =====================================================================
    -- 3) BOTÓN BASE
    -- =====================================================================
    sectionTitle(Content, "BOTÓN BASE", "BASE BUTTON", 4, "El círculo de atrás y su borde", "The circle behind and its border")
    local BaseCard = card(Content, 5)
    pad(BaseCard, 10, 10, 10, 10)
    list(BaseCard, 8)
    local baseChips = chips(BaseCard, { { "circle", "Con círculo", "With circle" }, { "none", "Solo imagen", "Image only" } }, 1, function(k)
        ED.rec.NoBackground = k == "none"
        refreshBaseCard()
        changed()
    end)
    local bgSwatch = swatchRow(BaseCard, 2, "Color del círculo", "Circle color", function() return ED.rec.BgColor end, function(c) ED.rec.BgColor = c end, "Del tema", "Theme")
    local borderSwatch = swatchRow(BaseCard, 3, "Color del borde", "Border color", function() return ED.rec.BorderColor end, function(c) ED.rec.BorderColor = c end, "Del tema", "Theme")
    refreshBaseCard = function()
        baseChips.Set(ED.rec.NoBackground and "none" or "circle")
        bgSwatch.Row.Visible = not ED.rec.NoBackground
        borderSwatch.Row.Visible = not ED.rec.NoBackground
        bgSwatch.Refresh()
        borderSwatch.Refresh()
    end

    -- =====================================================================
    -- 4) CAPAS
    -- =====================================================================
    sectionTitle(Content, "CAPAS", "LAYERS", 6, "Hasta 3 imágenes, cada una con su propio movimiento · la 1 queda atrás", "Up to 3 images, each with its own movement · layer 1 is at the back")
    local LayersHolder = mk("Frame", { Parent = Content, Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = 7, ZIndex = Z + 2 })
    list(LayersHolder, 10)
    local imageToken = {}

    -- revisa si la imagen carga (ContentProvider) y lo muestra en la píldora de la capa
    local function checkImage(index, url, pill)
        imageToken[index] = (imageToken[index] or 0) + 1
        local my = imageToken[index]
        local function show(es, en, color)
            if imageToken[index] ~= my or not pill.Parent then return end
            L(pill, es, en)
            pill.BackgroundColor3 = color
        end
        if url == "" then
            show("Sin imagen", "No image", Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 130))
            return
        end
        show("Cargando...", "Loading...", Color3.fromRGB(200, 150, 40))
        task.spawn(function()
            local result = nil
            pcall(function()
                ContentProvider:PreloadAsync({ url }, function(_, status)
                    result = status
                end)
            end)
            if result == Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success then
                show("Lista", "Ready", Color3.fromRGB(40, 170, 90))
            elseif result == Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Failure then
                show("No carga", "Not loading", Color3.fromRGB(205, 60, 70))
            else
                show("Sin respuesta", "No answer", Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 130))
            end
        end)
    end

    local function layerCard(index)
        local lay = ED.rec.Layers[index]
        local c = card(LayersHolder, index)
        pad(c, 10, 10, 10, 10)
        list(c, 8)

        -- cabecera: número + estado de la imagen + quitar
        local head = mk("Frame", { Parent = c, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = 1, ZIndex = Z + 3 })
        local num = mk("TextLabel", { Parent = head, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent, Text = tostring(index), TextColor3 = Theme.AccentText, TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, ZIndex = Z + 4 })
        num:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
        num:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "AccentText")
        num:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)
        corner(num, 999)
        label(head, "Capa " .. index, "Layer " .. index, 12, Enum.Font.GothamBlack, "Text", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(70, 24), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 0), ZIndex = Z + 4 })
        local pill = mk("TextLabel", { Parent = head, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 18), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 3), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 130), TextColor3 = WHITE, TextSize = 9, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, ZIndex = Z + 4 })
        pill:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)
        corner(pill, 999)
        pad(pill, 0, 8, 8, 0)
        if #ED.rec.Layers > 1 then
            local del = button(head, "Quitar", "Remove", "Background", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(66, 24), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), TextSize = 10 })
            del.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                table.remove(ED.rec.Layers, index)
                rebuildLayerCards()
                changed()
            end)
        end

        -- imagen: miniatura + ID + botón de miniatura (rbxthumb) por si el ID es de un decal
        local imgRow = mk("Frame", { Parent = c, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 48), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = 2, ZIndex = Z + 3 })
        local thumbBox = mk("Frame", { Parent = imgRow, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(48, 48), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 236), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = Z + 4 })
        corner(thumbBox, 10)
        local thumb = mk("ImageLabel", { Parent = thumbBox, Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 1, -6), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Image = CL.CleanAsset(lay.Image), ImageColor3 = lay.Color or WHITE, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit, ZIndex = Z + 5 })
        local idBox = mk("TextBox", {
            Parent = imgRow,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -140, 0, 32),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 56, 0.5, -16),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.2,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Text = lay.Image or "",
            PlaceholderColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
            TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
            TextSize = 11,
            Font = Enum.Font.Code,
            ClearTextOnFocus = false,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            ZIndex = Z + 4,
        })
        idBox:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
        idBox:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
        idBox:SetAttribute("PlaceholderSpanish", "ID de la imagen")
        idBox:SetAttribute("PlaceholderEnglish", "Image ID")
        idBox.PlaceholderText = GetText("ID de la imagen", "Image ID")
        corner(idBox, 9)
        pad(idBox, 0, 10, 10, 0)
        local thumbBtn = button(imgRow, "Miniatura", "Thumbnail", "Background", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(76, 32), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0), TextSize = 10 })
        local function applyImage(raw)
            lay.Image = CL.CleanAsset(raw)
            idBox.Text = lay.Image
            thumb.Image = lay.Image
            checkImage(index, lay.Image, pill)
            changed()
        end
        idBox.FocusLost:Connect(function() applyImage(idBox.Text) end)
        thumbBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            local id = tostring(lay.Image or ""):match("(%d+)")
            if not id then
                setStatus("Primero poné un ID en la capa " .. index, "Put an ID in layer " .. index .. " first", Color3.fromRGB(235, 90, 90))
                return
            end
            -- miniatura del asset: suele funcionar cuando pegaste el ID de un decal en vez del de la imagen
            applyImage("rbxthumb://type=Asset&id=" .. id .. "&w=420&h=420")
            setStatus("Capa " .. index .. ": ahora usa la miniatura del asset", "Layer " .. index .. ": now uses the asset thumbnail", Theme.Accent)
        end)
        checkImage(index, CL.CleanAsset(lay.Image), pill)

        -- movimiento
        local moveOpts = {}
        for _, m in ipairs(MOVES) do moveOpts[#moveOpts + 1] = { m[1], m[2], m[3] } end
        local speedS, amountS, dirChips, styleChips
        local function refreshMovement()
            local info = MOVE_INFO[lay.Movement] or {}
            speedS.Holder.Visible = info.speed ~= nil
            amountS.Holder.Visible = info.amount ~= nil
            dirChips.Row.Visible = info.dir == true
            styleChips.Row.Visible = info.style == true
            if info.speed then speedS.Configure(info.speed, info.speed[6], info.speed[7], lay.Speed) end
            if info.amount then amountS.Configure(info.amount, info.amount[6], info.amount[7], lay.Amount ~= 0 and lay.Amount or info.amount[4]) end
            dirChips.Set(lay.Direction == -1 and -1 or 1)
            styleChips.Set(lay.Style == "Constant" and "Constant" or "Organic")
        end
        local moveChips = chips(c, moveOpts, 3, function(key)
            lay.Movement = key
            local info = MOVE_INFO[key] or {}
            -- al cambiar de movimiento, valores por defecto con sentido para ese movimiento
            if info.speed then lay.Speed = info.speed[4] end
            lay.Amount = info.amount and info.amount[4] or 0
            refreshMovement()
            changed()
        end)
        moveChips.Set(lay.Movement)
        speedS = slider(c, 4, "Velocidad", "Speed", { 10, 600, 5, 60, "" }, lay.Speed, function(v) lay.Speed = v changed() end)
        amountS = slider(c, 5, "Intensidad", "Amount", { 0, 10, 1, 0, "" }, lay.Amount, function(v) lay.Amount = v changed() end)
        dirChips = chips(c, { { 1, "Horario", "Clockwise" }, { -1, "Antihorario", "Counter-clockwise" } }, 6, function(k) lay.Direction = k changed() end, 26)
        styleChips = chips(c, { { "Organic", "Orgánico (acelera y frena)", "Organic (speeds up & slows)" }, { "Constant", "Constante", "Constant" } }, 7, function(k) lay.Style = k changed() end, 26)
        slider(c, 8, "Tamaño", "Size", { 0.4, 4, 0.05, 1.6, "x" }, lay.Scale, function(v) lay.Scale = v changed() end)
        slider(c, 9, "Transparencia", "Transparency", { 0, 0.9, 0.05, 0, "" }, lay.Transparency or 0, function(v) lay.Transparency = v changed() end)
        local tint = swatchRow(c, 10, "Teñir la imagen", "Tint the image", function() return lay.Color end, function(col)
            lay.Color = col
            thumb.ImageColor3 = col or WHITE
        end, "Original", "Original")
        tint.Refresh()
        refreshMovement()
        return c
    end

    local AddLayerBtn = button(Content, "+  Agregar capa", "+  Add layer", "Secondary", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 38), LayoutOrder = 8, TextSize = 12 })
    AddLayerBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if #ED.rec.Layers >= 3 then return end
        table.insert(ED.rec.Layers, blankLayer(""))
        rebuildLayerCards()
        changed()
        task.defer(function()
            Content.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, math.max(0, AddLayerBtn.AbsolutePosition.Y - Content.AbsolutePosition.Y + Content.CanvasPosition.Y - 260))
        end)
    end)
    rebuildLayerCards = function()
        activeSlider = nil
        for _, ch in ipairs(LayersHolder:GetChildren()) do
            if ch:IsA("Frame") then ch:Destroy() end
        end
        for i = 1, #ED.rec.Layers do
            layerCard(i)
        end
        AddLayerBtn.Visible = #ED.rec.Layers < 3
    end

    -- =====================================================================
    -- 5) SONIDOS
    -- =====================================================================
    sectionTitle(Content, "SONIDOS (OPCIONAL)", "SOUNDS (OPTIONAL)", 9, "Al tocar el botón y uno de fondo mientras flota", "On tap, plus an ambient one while it floats")
    local SoundCard = card(Content, 10)
    pad(SoundCard, 10, 10, 10, 10)
    list(SoundCard, 8)
    local function soundInput(order, es, en, getId, setId, getVol)
        local row = mk("Frame", { Parent = SoundCard, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 52), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = order, ZIndex = Z + 3 })
        label(row, es, en, 11, Enum.Font.GothamBold, "Text", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16), ZIndex = Z + 4 })
        local box = mk("TextBox", {
            Parent = row,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -84, 0, 30),
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 20),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.2,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Text = "",
            PlaceholderColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
            TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
            TextSize = 11,
            Font = Enum.Font.Code,
            ClearTextOnFocus = false,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            ZIndex = Z + 4,
        })
        box:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
        box:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
        box:SetAttribute("PlaceholderSpanish", "ID del sonido (vacío = el de siempre)")
        box:SetAttribute("PlaceholderEnglish", "Sound ID (empty = default)")
        box.PlaceholderText = GetText("ID del sonido (vacío = el de siempre)", "Sound ID (empty = default)")
        corner(box, 9)
        pad(box, 0, 10, 10, 0)
        local test = button(row, "Probar", "Test", "Accent", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(76, 30), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20), TextSize = 11 })
        box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
            setId(CL.CleanAsset(box.Text))
            box.Text = getId()
        end)
        test.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            local id = CL.CleanAsset(box.Text)
            if id == "" then
                playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.6)
            else
                playSound(id, getVol())
            end
        end)
        return box
    end
    local clickBox = soundInput(1, "Sonido al tocar", "Tap sound", function() return ED.rec.ClickSound.Id end, function(v) ED.rec.ClickSound.Id = v end, function() return ED.rec.ClickSound.Volume end)
    local clickVol = slider(SoundCard, 2, "Volumen al tocar", "Tap volume", { 0, 1, 0.05, 0.6, "" }, 0.6, function(v) ED.rec.ClickSound.Volume = v end)
    local idleBox = soundInput(3, "Sonido de fondo (con la ventana cerrada)", "Ambient sound (window closed)", function() return ED.rec.IdleSound.Id end, function(v) ED.rec.IdleSound.Id = v end, function() return ED.rec.IdleSound.Volume end)
    local idleEvery = slider(SoundCard, 4, "Cada cuántos segundos", "Every how many seconds", { 3, 120, 1, 15, "s" }, 15, function(v) ED.rec.IdleSound.Interval = v end)
    local idleVol = slider(SoundCard, 5, "Volumen de fondo", "Ambient volume", { 0, 1, 0.05, 0.15, "" }, 0.15, function(v) ED.rec.IdleSound.Volume = v end)
    refreshSoundCard = function()
        clickBox.Text = ED.rec.ClickSound.Id or ""
        clickVol.Set(ED.rec.ClickSound.Volume or 0.6, false)
        idleBox.Text = ED.rec.IdleSound.Id or ""
        idleEvery.Set(ED.rec.IdleSound.Interval or 15, false)
        idleVol.Set(ED.rec.IdleSound.Volume or 0.15, false)
    end

    -- =====================================================================
    -- 6) COMPARTIR
    -- =====================================================================
    sectionTitle(Content, "COMPARTIR", "SHARE", 11, "Pasale el código a un amigo y él lo pega acá", "Send the code to a friend and they paste it here")
    local ShareCard = card(Content, 12)
    pad(ShareCard, 10, 10, 10, 10)
    list(ShareCard, 8)
    local CodeBox = mk("TextBox", {
        Parent = ShareCard,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32),
        BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.2,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Text = "",
        PlaceholderColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
        TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
        TextSize = 10,
        Font = Enum.Font.Code,
        ClearTextOnFocus = false,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
        LayoutOrder = 1,
        ZIndex = Z + 4,
    })
    CodeBox:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
    CodeBox:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
    CodeBox:SetAttribute("PlaceholderSpanish", "Pegá acá un código YYLOGO1:...")
    CodeBox:SetAttribute("PlaceholderEnglish", "Paste a YYLOGO1:... code here")
    CodeBox.PlaceholderText = GetText("Pegá acá un código YYLOGO1:...", "Paste a YYLOGO1:... code here")
    corner(CodeBox, 9)
    pad(CodeBox, 0, 10, 10, 0)
    local shareRow = mk("Frame", { Parent = ShareCard, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = 2, ZIndex = Z + 3 })
    local
